compatibility.role: historical/compatibility investigation; not a v1 supported-runtime claim
notes: PyTorch 2.6 official wheels stop at CUDA 12.6.
RTX 5090/sm_120 requires CUDA 12.8+; therefore LYG RTX 5090 cannot substitute for a real RTX 3090/Ampere compatibility qualification.

candidates.rationale: RTX 5090 is Blackwell sm_120; CUDA 12.8+ is required, so cu126 is not a valid LYG Gate B candidate.

notes: On LYG RTX 5090, eager and compile-default GDKVM forward paths execute under PyTorch 2.14.0+cu130.
compile-default has a large cold-start cost and is not the reference/default path.
reduce-overhead is currently unsupported because CUDA Graph lifetime conflicts with persistent positional-encoding cache state.
Tiny synthetic training screening did not show a channels-last, FP16, or BF16 advantage over FP32 eager; these remain opt-in until real workload qualification.

notes.modern_current_official: PyTorch 2.14.0; initial common CUDA wheel candidate cu126
notes.compile_modes_source: public torch.compile modes; eager is the non-compiled reference
